references.text: God's original instruction to Moses to make fifty gold hooks to fasten the curtains together, which is here carried out in practice.
Parallel instruction about hooks that were to be used to fasten the tent curtains together into one whole.
Describes the fifty bronze hooks made for the tent curtains, a parallel construction to the gold hooks.
Moses sets up the tabernacle and erects it as one continuous structure, the result of the work with the hooks.
The theme of unity - just as the tabernacle became one through the hooks, the psalm praises the unity among God's people.
The church as God's temple is joined together into a whole, a spiritual counterpart to the physical tabernacle's unity.
